[[File:Leona.png|thumb|250px|Leona]] '''Leona''' (Japanese: '''ユモミ''' ''Yumomi'') is a minor recurring character who first appeared in ''[[DP063|Hot Springing a Leak!]]''. [[File:Dawn and Leona.png|thumb|left|220px|Dawn and Leona as children]] Leona is a childhood friend of {{an|Dawn}} and {{si|Kenny}}, and she also sometimes calls Dawn '''Dee Dee''' (Japanese: '''ピカリ''' ''Pikari''). She lives near a hot spring with her [[Leona's parents|parents]] and takes care of three {{p|Swinub}}. In ''[[DP063|Hot Springing a Leak!]]'', Leona had the water from her hot spring stolen by someone. She later found out that {{TRT}} was siphoning the water from her hot spring's main pipe, planning to use it to start their own hot spring. Later, she and Dawn defeated Team Rocket and returned the water to her own hot spring. When she parted ways from {{an|Dawn}}, {{Ash}}, and {{an|Brock}}, Leona told them that she would go and {{pkmn|battle}} in Sinnoh's [[Gym]]s. It is unknown if she has any [[Badge]]s yet. Pilar Martín (child; [[DP161]])}} ==Trivia== * Leona has a similar character design to that of {{si|Kenny}}, having similar hairstyles and clothes, and also being Dawn's childhood friend. Both also call Dawn "Dee Dee" sometimes. * Leona is also similar to [[Peggy]], who appeared in ''[[EP188|Spring Fever]]'', because she has three Swinub in her possession and runs a {{wp|hot spring}}. The only slight difference is that Peggy was still building her own hot spring with [[Rory|her father]]. * Dawn, who is notably Leona's best friend, would later go on to capture her own {{TP|Dawn|Swinub}}, the only Pokémon Leona has. * Leona's Japanese name comes from 湯もみ ''Yumomi'', a traditional method of cooling down hot spring water using wooden paddles. {{-}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Animation characters]] [[Category:Female characters]] [[de:Thermalquelle mit Leck!#Leona]] [[es:Leona]] [[fr:Leona]] [[it:Leona]] [[ja:ユモミ]] [[zh:汤红]]
